why: issue 0829. Replaces each `SYSTEM_DEFAULT` field with the backend's own answer, and is called by every backend at its create entry. rclrs has no counterpart because upstream never resolves the sentinel in the client library: `rmw_qos_profile_system_default` is passed down untouched and each `librmw_*_cpp.so` resolves it internally, differently -- `rmw_cyclonedds_cpp`'s `create_readwrite_qos` gives `KEEP_LAST, 1`, `rmw_zenoh_cpp`'s `QoS::QoS()` gives `RMW_ZENOH_DEFAULT_HISTORY_DEPTH` (42). We link ONE backend at build time and our backends are Rust crates implementing `nros_rmw::Session` from other crates, so the same per-backend resolution has to be a public item on the shared `QoSProfile` rather than private C++ inside a dynamically-loaded plugin. One shared helper, not three spellings.
